en: Sepia-toned postcard view of a small European town with a prominent large Gothic-style church featuring two tall square towers with steep spires and a long nave with pointed-arch windows. In the foreground are fields, trees, and a footpath leading towards half-timbered and stone houses. The town spreads out behind the church with additional buildings and a distant smokestack. The caption "Geithain i. Sa." appears at the bottom left.
